shortDescription: NTA has released the UGC NET June 2026 re-exam answer key for the examination held on 09-10 September 2026. Download it from the official candidate login portal.
content:
National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the UGC NET June Re-Exam Answer Key 2026 on the official UGC NET website. The re-examination was conducted on 09-10 September 2026.

Candidates can download the answer key and response sheet by logging in with their application or enrollment number and date of birth or password. Check the question paper and response details carefully, and submit objections through the official portal if the objection window is open.

The original application process ran from 29 April 2026 to 24 May 2026. The regular examination was held from 22-30 June 2026, and the re-exam answer key was released on 10 September 2026.
